project_type: React 18.3.1 + TypeScript 5.5.4 single-page app (Vite 5.4.3) backed by Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Realtime + Storage). Single bundle, no client router.
build_system: npm + Vite. Build is `tsc -b && vite build`. Only runtime dependency is @supabase/supabase-js 2.45.4 — do NOT add new runtime deps (navigation is state-based, not react-router).
test_framework: Vitest 2.0.5 with jsdom; @testing-library/react + jest-dom. Unit tests are co-located as *.test.ts(x). The RLS integration suite (src/__tests__/rls.integration.test.ts) uses @vitest-environment node and skips-with-reason when live env vars are absent.
verification_instructions: Run in order: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit), `npm run lint` (eslint src), `npm run test` (vitest run), `npm run build` (tsc -b && vite build). Baseline (green) is 89 passed / 9 skipped — the 9 skips are the RLS integration suite with no live backend, which is the expected local state. Full RLS verification requires a live Supabase project with 0003 applied + the two storage buckets created (see SETUP.md) and the RLS_TEST_* env vars set.
environment_constraints: No live Supabase backend in this worktree, so the RLS integration suite skips with a printed reason — that is expected, not a failure. SQL migrations are not compiled or run locally; migration correctness is proved by the RLS integration suite against a live project, not by a local runner. Windows + PowerShell shell.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering files exist. README.md + SETUP.md are the authoritative docs. Hard rule from requirements: ALL schema changes go in the NEW migration supabase/migrations/0003_classboard_ext.sql; 0001_init.sql and 0002_deadline_timestamptz.sql MUST NOT be modified. Commit locally on the branch; never push.
key_patterns: RLS is the ONLY authorization boundary: src/data/mutations.ts wrappers trust RLS (no client role checks) and return a MutationResult via classify() (42xxx/RLS -> 'denied', else 'network'); MUTATION_MESSAGES maps those to copy. Realtime reads delegate to src/data/useRealtimeTable.ts (fetch select * unconditionally, reconcile strictly by `id`, focus/visibility self-heal, VITE_REALTIME_FALLBACK poll). Anonymous visitors always get public read; session is never a read gate for public tables. is_officer() is a SECURITY DEFINER helper reused everywhere, never re-implemented. 0001 ordering = enums -> tables -> enable RLS -> table GRANTs (privileges gate access FIRST) -> named role-explicit policies -> publication. Pure domain logic lives in src/lib/* (derive.ts, sorting.ts, theme-core.ts) with co-located *.test.ts and strict 'YYYY-MM-DD' string-date discipline (localTodayISO, never new Date() for date-only comparisons). Colors come ONLY from CSS tokens in src/styles/tokens.css (two blocks: html[data-mode='dark'] and html[data-mode='light']); theme-core.ts resolveTokens is a closed map and is NOT extended for the new fixed per-mode tokens (treat them like --danger). Every dialog uses the shared Modal (role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trap, Esc, focus restore). Every interactive element is a real <button>/<input> with the global --focus-ring. Context providers (SessionProvider, ThemeProvider) are the pattern for NavProvider. Date picking reuses CalendarField (value is 'YYYY-MM-DD' | '').
